description: Make an image file smaller: re-encode at a quality (default 80) and optionally cap the longest side (maxSide), as JPEG, WebP, AVIF or PNG ("keep" = same format; GIF/BMP/TIFF become PNG). Or give targetBytes to find the highest quality that fits that size. With keepSmaller (default on) the original is kept when re-encoding would not make it smaller. Reports before/after sizes and % saved. Transparent areas become white in JPEG. Metadata (EXIF, GPS) is not copied. PNG is lossless (quality ignored). Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/image-squeeze/

format.description: Output format. Default keep (same as the input).

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

keepSmaller.description: Keep the original bytes when the result would be larger (same format and size only). Default true.

maxSide.description: Scale down so the longest side is at most this many pixels (e.g. 1920).

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

quality.description: Quality 1-100 for JPEG / WebP / AVIF. Default 80 (website default).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

targetBytes.description: Aim for a file of at most this many bytes: searches the highest quality that fits (lossy formats only; overrides quality).

name: image_compress
title: Compress image
